_editing_note: Photo albums. To add one: copy an existing block, give it a new `id`, and put the photographs in assets/source/gallery/<your-folder>/ then run `npm run images`. `photos` entries need a `file` (path without extension, relative to assets/source) and an `alt` describing what is in the picture for someone who cannot see it.
